css-01.title: CSS Module 1 Quiz
css-01.description: Test your understanding of CSS selectors and specificity.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a CSS selector?
options: To select HTML elements that will be styled
questions.explanation: A CSS selector identifies the HTML elements to which CSS rules should be applied.

questions.question: Which selector targets all elements with the class name card?
questions.explanation: A period . is used before a class name in a CSS selector.

questions.question: Which selector targets an element with the ID header?
questions.explanation: A hash # is used to select an element by its ID.

questions.question: Which CSS selector has the highest specificity among these options?
questions.explanation: An ID selector generally has higher specificity than a class selector, element selector, or universal selector.

questions.question: What does CSS specificity help determine?
options: Which CSS rule takes priority when multiple rules target the same element
questions.explanation: Specificity is part of the process browsers use to determine which CSS declarations take precedence when rules conflict.

css-02.title: CSS Module 2 Quiz
css-02.description: Test your understanding of the CSS Box Model.

questions.question: Which four parts make up the CSS Box Model?
questions.explanation: The CSS Box Model consists of content, padding, border, and margin.

questions.question: What is the purpose of padding?
options: Space between the content and the border
questions.explanation: Padding creates space inside an element, between its content and its border.

questions.question: What is the purpose of margin?
options: Space between text and an image
The thickness of an element's border
questions.explanation: Margin creates space outside the element's border.

questions.question: Which property controls the border around an element?
questions.explanation: The border property controls an element's border.

questions.question: What does box-sizing: border-box generally do?
options: Includes padding and border in the declared width and height
Changes the element into a flex container
questions.explanation: With border-box, the declared width and height include the element's content, padding, and border.
